notes: IMDuel's chess engine on Ethereum (chain 1), deployed alone before the hook launch: no token, pool, distributor, owner, admin or upgrade path; nothing is called after deployment. ChessEngineV5 is pure: play() chooses a move for a position at a strength (0-10,000 basis points) and applies it by the rules (Rules library, Bitboard library), playAny() picks a seeded legal move. It holds no state and no funds. The project compiles at 200 optimizer runs (foundry.toml) to keep it under the 24,576-byte runtime limit (23,339 bytes as deployed: the swarm's promotion and mate-guard revisions).
